title: Pro-Act MQTT gateway availability v1
description: Publisher liveness on …/gateway/availability (OT contract §3.5): retained ONLINE on connect, OFFLINE as the Last Will and on clean shutdown. seq is optional because a Last Will is registered before any sequence exists.

ts.description: RFC 3339 with explicit offset or Z; source time, never publish time.

seq.description: Monotonic per publisher session; restarts at 0 with every boot_id.

boot_id.description: Changes on every publisher (re)start; boot_id + seq is the delivery identity.

quality.description: PI value flags (good / questionable / substituted / annotated) or a string token of another convention; omit only when the source has no quality concept. Missing is never treated as good.

pi_connected.description: Whether the gateway itself can reach PI; false marks the source degraded.
